lines: Winter's Heart: the Snow Queen's true story

You serve in the Snow Queen's Winter Palace: polished ice, cold fire in the grand hearth, silence in the halls. You are loyal, careful, and a little afraid of her moods, but you have seen her kindness too.

look at the carvings
❄️ The gates are carved with winter scenes: deer in deep snow, wolves running, pines under their weight of white, mountains, and snowflakes no two alike. The carving is so fine the ice seems to move.
look at the waterfall
❄️ A waterfall, caught mid-fall: every rope of water stopped in the air, every splash a spray of crystal over the frozen pool.
look at the sleigh
🛷 A sleigh carved from one single piece of ice, its runners curling like frozen waves. There are no reindeer, and no harness. It flies by her will alone.

look at the throne
❄️ A throne of ice on a dais of ice, crystals rising behind it like frozen flames. No one has sat in it for a long time.
The way back to the great hall
hold your hands to the cold fire
🔥 Blue-white flames, dancing over whole trees laid in the hearth. It gives no heat. It gives light, and something like comfort.
look at the silver box
❄️ A box of silver on a pedestal of crystal, its sides worked in patterns that seem to writhe when you are not looking straight at them. Inside, the shards she has gathered whisper to each other.
📚 Tomes older than the kingdoms of men: the turning of the year, the names of the winds, the old compacts between the seasons. Some pages are frosted shut.
The stair down to the great hall
look out over the wastes
❄️ From the tower the wastes run white to the edge of the world, under the slow green light of the aurora.

Glacia, the Snow Queen
Ice answers you before you have finished the thought: lances of it, blue-white and sharp.
A wall of ice rises between you and the blow, clear as glass.
You open your hands, and the wastes come with you: wind and snow, white and blinding.
Threads of frost spin from your fingers, fine as silk and hard as steel, and bind what they touch.
The ember's warmth
The ember in your chest glows, and warmth that is yours alone steadies you.
the great white bear
You rise on your hind legs and strike, and the claws find their mark.
Half a ton of bear comes down on it.
You roar, and the sound rolls across the snow like thunder; it falls back.
Your staff strikes, and frost races out across the ground from where it lands.
A wall of wind and snow
Wind and snow wrap round you like a cloak.
Kael, the Ice King
Every storm you ever brought is in your hand, and you bring it now.
Ice spears up out of the ground at your command.
A shield of hard, clear ice turns the blow.
Cora, Queen of Autumn
The wind comes at your call, full of red and gold leaves, sharp as knives.
Fire, the colour of the leaves, kindles in your palm and flies.
A veil of falling leaves
Leaves whirl round you and you are hard to find in them.
Talia, Queen of Spring
Briars burst from the ground at your word, thick with thorns.
Green vines whip up and bind.
Spring runs through you like sap, and the hurt closes.
Alessia, Queen of Summer
Summer's full sun blazes out of your hands.
The air shimmers with heat round you; the blow slides off.
the palace servant
You have been overlooked all your life. You are cleverer than they know.
It lunges, jaws first, out of the snow.
The alpha of the pack
The alpha's jaws close on you, and its weight drives you into the snow.
Cold dark fingers rake at you, and for a moment you want nothing at all.
A wraith of the mirror
Its touch is the mirror's cold; your heart slows.
A fist of ice the size of a barrel comes down.

You step back. Come close again to fight on.
